entries.previous_entry: [character:9425235|Alyzira Galanodel] is a half-elf bard who carries herself with a slender yet athletic build. Strikingly charming and inherently charismatic, she naturally steps forward as the eloquent, persuasive "face" of her adventuring party during high-stakes negotiations and social maneuvers. Her true passion lies in performance—where her sharp wits and musical talents shine beautifully in private or casual settings. However, [character:9425235|Alyzira] harbors a hilarious and deeply ironic curse: the moment a formal audience gathers to watch her perform, her standard bardic grace utterly vanishes, transforming her otherwise masterful art into a brilliantly comedic disaster. Recently, [character:9425235|Alyzira] assisted in an investigation of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward], where she successfully picked a front door lock to grant her party entry. During a confrontation with the City Watch, she utilized her persuasive skills to fast-talk Captain [character:9432045|Hyustus Staget], successfully explaining the party's presence and helping to avoid legal repercussions for the group. During a recent excursion into the [location:9418490|Waterdeep] sewers, [character:9425235|Alyzira] was briefly stunned and mentally incapacitated when a [creature:9432254|Intellect Devourer] leaped onto her during a skirmish with the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild]. Following the battle, she gathered the remaining coin and valuables from the site. She also played a pivotal role in securing the party's new base, using her magic to probe and calm a resident poltergeist named Leif within [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor], successfully negotiating the spirit's demands for a thorough cleaning of the property. Alyzira has recently expanded her influence and connections within the city. She successfully distracted a theater attendant at the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] to facilitate a clandestine meeting with [character:9435899|Mirt] "the Merciless" of the [organisation:9419383|Harpers]. Furthermore, she was formally welcomed into the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave] by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon] at the [location:9435917|Phaulkonmere Villa], where she received a [item:9435948|charm of restoration]. During a recent quest for the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], Alyzira helped investigate reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517] farmlands. She used her magic to detect the thoughts of one of the creatures, identifying its eerie mental chant, and destroyed it with a Fireball. She also played a key role in the investigation of the local farmers, eventually using her charm magic to compel a local woman named Donya to confess to animating the creatures. For her efforts in saving the farmlands, Alyzira earned +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. In a recent skirmish in the [location:9438959|Field Ward], Alyzira was involved in a brawl between rival thugs. While attempting to use non-lethal means to break up the fight, she accidentally dealt fatal blows, killing two of the thugs. Most recently, while exploring the neighborhood around [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor], Alyzira engaged in community building by distributing invitations for a free drink to local shopkeepers. She also participated in a mission for the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave] to investigate necromantic disturbances in the [location:9438979] cemetery. After patrolling the grounds and surviving an ambush of skeletons, she helped breach a shrine to confront Priest [character:9442159], who was being controlled by a glowing geometric tablet. Following the successful capture of the priest, Alyzira earned an additional +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave].

entries.previous_entry: [character:9425236|Eoula] is a diminutive female halfling ranger of mature years, possessing an exceptionally light and delicate frame. Deeply intellectual, she harbors a profound love for books and reading, though this quiet studiousness leaves her horribly awkward and out of her element in social situations. In combat, she primarily trusts her shortbow, but she also delights in unleashing sticky webs from her prized spider staff—a choice of weaponry wrapped in deep irony, given her intense dislike of actual spiders. Above all, [character:9425236|Eoula] possesses a fiercely compassionate heart for animals, driven by a protective nature that simply cannot bear to see creatures of the wild come to any harm. During a recent investigation of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward], [character:9425236|Eoula] demonstrated her tactical utility by using her [ability:9442180|Web] spell to neutralize a group of Kenku ambushers. During the same investigation, she discovered [character:9431743|Renaer Neverember] hiding in a small room, where he provided crucial information regarding the disappearance of [character:9431741|Floon] and the search for the [item:9432044|Stone of Golorr]. More recently, [character:9425236|Eoula] navigated the [location:9418490|Waterdeep] sewers and successfully rescued [character:9431741|Floon] from the clutches of the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild]. During the confrontation, she attempted to snatch a stone eye necklace from the Mind Flayer [character:9432251|Nihiloor] but was tossed aside as he escaped through a magical portal. Following the rescue, [character:9425236|Eoula] initially expressed a desire for signed copies of [character:9418259|Volothamp Geddarm]’s books as payment for the rescue, though she ultimately agreed to the group's acquisition of [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor]. Eoula recently traveled to the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] in the [location:9431883|Sea Ward] for an opera, where the party received a mission from the [organisation:9419383|Harpers] to locate a talking draft horse. She subsequently visited the [location:9435917|Phaulkononmere Villa] in the [location:9435916|South Ward], where she was formally welcomed as a member of the local Enclave by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon]. As part of this membership, she was bestowed with a [item:9435948|charm of restoration]. While investigating reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517|Undercliff Way], [character:9425236|Eoula] utilized her tracking skills to follow stick-like footprints heading west. She also consulted her magical diary to uncover a local secret regarding the motives of the villagers involved. Following the successful neutralization of the scarecrows and the capture of the witch Donya, [character:9425236|Eoula] earned renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. Eoula recently visited the [location:9438977] to purchase a curious volume titled The [item:9438978] for 25 gold pieces. She also participated in the group's efforts to fund the renovations and guild fees for [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor], which has now been successfully funded. During a neighborhood stroll through [location:9419015], she performed community outreach by handing out invitations for a free drink at [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor] to local shopkeepers. Most recently, while patrolling the [location:9438979] (the local cemetery) on behalf of the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], she was ambushed by a group of skeletons. Following the skirmish, she used her [ability:9442180|Web] spell to restrain Priest [character:9442159], who was under the influence of a dark artifact. Her efforts, along with those of her companions, resulted in the successful capture of the priest and earned her additional renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave].

entries.proposed_entry:
The House of Inspired Hands is a large temple complex dedicated to Gond, the wonderbringer, located in the [location:9431883]. The oldest buildings in the complex are also some of the oldest buildings in the city, having been constructed as a walled monastery and trade mission by merchant-monks.

The complex is known for its mechanical innovations and contains the [location:9442786] (the Temple of Gond). Recent events include an investigation into a rogue nimblewright automaton that fled the temple. The temple is overseen by Lady [character:9442787], a bronze dragonborn priestess, and houses [character:9442788], a mute and emotionless "nimblewright" automaton made of wood and metal.

entries.previous_entry: Nim is a unique, sentient nimblewright residing at the [location:9442786] (the temple of Gond) in [location:9418490]. As a miraculous, non-speaking construct of wood and brass, he spends his time inventing things and tinkering.
entries.proposed_entry:
Nim is a unique, sentient nimblewright residing at the [location:9442786] (the temple of Gond) in [location:9418490]. As a miraculous, non-speaking construct of wood and brass, he spends his time inventing things and tinkering.

It was recently discovered that Nim has grown terribly lonely and built a secondary nimblewright friend for company. This creation panicked, fled the temple in terror, and has been missing for a month.
entries.change_summary: Updated the synopsis to include Nim's loneliness and the fact that he created a second, currently missing, nimblewright companion.

entries.previous_entry: Trollskull Alley is a narrow, character-rich street in [location:9418490]’s [location:9431893|North Ward], best known as the home of the famously restored [location:9418605]. Once a quieter, somewhat run-down part of the city, the alley has become a lively hub for adventurers, craftsmen, and eccentrics drawn to the revitalized manor and its ever-changing clientele. Its buildings are a mix of old stone townhouses and quirky shops, with an atmosphere that shifts between cozy neighborhood charm and the occasional burst of chaos when adventurers return from their latest misadventures. The alley is home to several local businesses, including [location:9442089], [location:9442091], [location:9442094], [location:9442096], and [location:9438977]. A local sewer entrance is also located within the alley. Though still part of a relatively safe district, Trollskull Alley has a habit of attracting strange events, secret meetings, and the attention of powerful factions who keep an eye on anyone bold enough to make the manor their base of operations. Recently, the area has seen a shift in activity as [organisation:9419162|the party] took ownership of the manor, beginning a significant renovation project on the dilapidated property. The neighborhood now also contends with the presence of a resident poltergeist named Leif, a neat-freak spirit who demands the inn be kept in pristine condition. Recently, the alley was the site of a devastating magical explosion involving a fireball spell that left eleven people dead, including members of [organisation:9419438] and a gnome with ties to [organisation:9419437]. Witnesses reported seeing a mechanical automaton, similar to those used in parades sponsored by the Temple of Gond, involved in the blast.

entries.previous_entry: [character:9425238|Tyde Undertow] is a striking, fey-touched or tiefling-like druid whose appearance beautifully bridges the gap between the wild earth and the deep ocean with vibrant blue skin transitioning into soft pink and silver tones across their limbs. Though her favorite wildshape forms for a fierce battle are a predatory wolf or a snapping crocodile, [character:9425238|Tyde]'s greatest challenge isn't a formidable enemy, but a simple map. Possessing absolutely zero sense of direction, she is blissfully incapable of getting from point A to point B without a guide, turning every simple journey into an accidental detour through the wilderness. Tyde was found lost in the sewers of [location:9418490|Waterdeep] while searching for nature. After being spotted by [organisation:9419162|the party], she joined their ranks. She assisted the group in rescuing [character:9431741|Floon Blagmaar] from the clutches of [character:9432251|Nihiloor] and [character:9432250|Grum’shar] within a [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild] hideout. During the skirmish, she managed to scramble out of the path of a [creature:9432254|Intellect Devourer] before the party defeated it. She is now a member of [organisation:9419162|the party] and a resident of [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor]. Recently, Tyde has begun expanding her ties with local factions. She was invited to join the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave] after a speaking cat approached her and [character:9425235|Alyzira]. She is particularly eager to work with the Enclave to locate her missing group of coastal druids. She was formally granted membership by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon] at [location:9435917|Phaulkonmere Villa], where she received a [item:9435948|charm of restoration] and a promise of assistance in finding her lost kin. Additionally, Tyde recently attended an opera at the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] in a sparkly silver-and-blue gown to maintain the party's social standing and investigate leads for the [organisation:9419383|Harpers]. Tyde recently assisted the party in investigating reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517] on Undercliff Way. For her role in defeating the scarecrows and saving the farmlands, she was awarded 20 Gold Pieces and gained +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. Most recently, while patrolling the [location:9438979] (the local cemetery) on behalf of the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], Tyde and her companions were ambushed by skeletons. During a subsequent confrontation with Priest [character:9442159] at the [location:9442141], Tyde was struck by a devastating spell that caused her to drop unconscious and die for the first time in her adventuring career, though she was quickly revived by [character:9423629]. Following the successful capture of the priest, Tyde earned an additional 10 gold pieces and +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave].

Ornate iron gates open onto manicured grounds dotted with flowering trees and winding paths that lead to a grand two-story mansion of polished brick and dark timber. Inside, soaring ceilings, crystal chandeliers, rich mahogany furnishings, family portraits, and lavish tapestries speak to generations of prosperity, while the atmosphere carries an undercurrent of tension—as though every polished surface conceals a hidden agenda. entries.previous_entry:
Renaer is the estranged son of [character:9457192|Dagult Neverember], the former Open Lord of Waterdeep and the current Lord of Neverwinter. Father and son detest one another. Renaer is least happy when he finds himself forced to deal with some mess his father left behind.

Qualities that both share include striking good looks, a love of drink, and a flair for diplomacy. What Renaer lacks is his father's belligerence, ill temper, and bad judgment.

Renaer lives off a sizable inheritance left to him by his mother, Alethea Brandath. Approaching middle age, he has given up adventuring and "settled down" somewhat. As a member of the [organisation:9419383], he spends a lot of time defending Waterdavians against those who, like his father, would deprive them of their coin and rights.

He owns [location:9443317|Brandarthall], a four-story residence in the [location:9431883]. Renaer spends as little time there as possible, however, since it's constantly under surveillance by spies loyal to his father. His friends have an open invitation to use the house as they please, while Renaer spends most of his free time in taverns and festhalls.

Some believe that Renaer's estrangement from his father is nothing but an act, and that anyone who bears the Neverember name is an enemy of [location:9418490]. Renaer just shakes his head at such accusations and gets on with his life. He has many powerful friends to watch his back.

Recently, Renaer was kidnapped by [organisation:9419438|Zhentarim] thugs who were searching for the [item:9432044|Stone of Golorr] in connection to alleged embezzlement by his father. He was discovered by a group of adventurers hiding in a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward]. During the rescue, it was revealed that his friend [character:9431741|Floon] was also abducted by the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild] in the confusion.

Renaer has recently acted as a patron for the party, providing a recommendation that allowed [character:9435899|Mirt] to officially recruit [character:9419631|Raucous] into the [organisation:9419383].

entries.previous_entry: [character:9423618|Gladio] is a human fighter whose imposing, powerful build bears the unmistakable marks of a seasoned warrior. A veteran with a history of soldiering, his disciplined martial background is perfectly balanced by a grounded, humble heart; when he isn't wielding a blade on the battlefield, he can often be found back home putting his immense strength to good use helping his parents tend to their farm. His mother has recently suffered a fall, and with his father growing older, Gladio has been focused on assisting them with their farm work. He was recently seen traveling to market in Neverwinter with a cart full of produce, such as squash. Despite his formidable presence and rugged past, [character:9423618|Gladio] harbors a delightfully simple and passionate culinary joy: an absolute, unyielding love for a hearty cup of noodles. Recently, Gladio provided tactical plans for an infiltration of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward], which led to the discovery of a hidden cache and the rescue of [character:9431743|Renaer Neverember]. Following the investigation, the party has ventured into the sewers to track the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild] in an attempt to rescue [character:9431741|Floon].

entries.proposed_entry:
Zardoz Zord is a flamboyant, jovial, kind, and gracious man. Unconcerned with city politics, his only aim is to bring joy and wonder to the hearts of people everywhere. He is the owner of the Sea Maidens Faire, a traveling carnival that has brought three galleons—the Heartbreaker, the Hellraiser, and his flashy flagship, the [location:9443986|Eyecatcher]—to [location:9418490|Waterdeep]. 

When not cavorting around the city promoting the debut of the Sea Maiden's Faire, he spends his time on his personal ship, the [location:9443986|Eyecatcher], anchored in the harbor, rehearsing with his all-human crew, indulging in his weakness for delectable foods and libations, or seducing any man or woman that stirs his loins. He is known to visit the distant island of Lantan once a year, from which he recently purchased four nimblewrights to serve as performing automatons aboard his vessels.

entries.previous_entry: [character:9423629|Orlum] is a gray-green tortle paladin who cuts an imposing figure with his tall stature and immense, heavy build. Bound by holy oaths, he possesses a remarkably straightforward and earnest mind, though his social interactions are often marked by a charming quirk: he takes whatever people say entirely literally, often missing figures of speech or sarcasm completely. Despite his formidable presence and martial devotion, [character:9423629|Orlum] harbors a gentle appreciation for sweet simple comforts. This is best exemplified by his absolute favorite possession—a magical pumpkin cupcake that miraculously replenishes itself, ensuring he is never without his preferred treat. During a recent skirmish in a Candle Lane alleyway, Orlum demonstrated his martial prowess by decisively cleaving one of the attackers in half. During a recent investigation of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse], Orlum successfully looted approximately 140 lbs of silver, a weight that left him heavily encumbered during the party's subsequent descent into the sewers. More recently, while navigating the [location:9418490|Waterdeep] sewers, Orlum faced a Mind Flayer named [character:9432251|Nihiloor]. Orlum attempted to block the Mind Flayer's path but was briefly dominated by its overwhelming psychic powers. However, he managed to break free of the mind control and decisively killed a half-orc named [character:9432250|Grum'shar] in a single hit. Recently, Orlum traveled to the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] in the [location:9431883|Sea Ward] to attend an opera, where he slipped away with [character:9425238|Tyde] and [character:9419631|Raucous] to meet [character:9435899|Mirt] "the Merciless." Following this meeting, the party has begun investigating leads regarding the [organisation:9419383|Harpers] and the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild]. Most recently, Orlum assisted in a quest to stop living scarecrows terrorizing the farmlands of Undercliff Way. During the investigation, he cast Zone of Truth over a group of local farmers to help uncover the truth behind the terror, eventually leading to the capture of a witch named Donya who had animated the creatures. Following a request from the [organisation:9419404], Orlum intervened in a gang war in the [location:9438959] to stop turf wars between rival thugs. For his efforts in keeping the peace, he was formally initiated into the [organisation:9419404] at the grand [location:9438976] in the [location:9431892], earning 1 Renown with the Order. More recently, Orlum and his companions responded to an urgent request from the [organisation:9419386] regarding a necromantic threat in the [location:9438979]. While patrolling the graveyard, the party was ambushed by skeletons. During a confrontation at the [location:9442141], Orlum rushed through flames to smash a glowing geometric artifact tablet, which successfully freed Priest [character:9442159] from a dark thrall. Following the capture of the priest, Orlum and his allies earned 1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386].

entries.previous_entry: [character:9425235|Alyzira Galanodel] is a half-elf bard who carries herself with a slender yet athletic build. Strikingly charming and inherently charismatic, she naturally steps forward as the eloquent, persuasive "face" of her adventuring party during high-stakes negotiations and social maneuvers. Her true passion lies in performance—where her sharp wits and musical talents shine beautifully in private or casual settings. However, [character:9425235|Alyzira] harbors a hilarious and deeply ironic curse: the moment a formal audience gathers to watch her perform, her standard bardic grace utterly vanishes, transforming her otherwise masterful art into a brilliantly comedic disaster. Recently, [character:9425235|Alyzira] assisted in an investigation of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward], where she successfully picked a front door lock to grant her party entry. During a confrontation with the City Watch, she utilized her persuasive skills to fast-talk Captain [character:9432045|Hyustus Staget], successfully explaining the party's presence and helping to avoid legal repercussions for the group. During a recent excursion into the [location:9418490|Waterdeep] sewers, [character:9425235|Alyzira] was briefly stunned and mentally incapacitated when a [creature:9432254|Intellect Devourer] leaped onto her during a skirmish with the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild]. Following the battle, she gathered the remaining coin and valuables from the site. She also played a pivotal role in securing the party's new base, using her magic to probe and calm a resident poltergeist named Leif within [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor], successfully negotiating the spirit's demands for a thorough cleaning of the property. Alyzira has recently expanded her influence and connections within the city. She successfully distracted a theater attendant at the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] to facilitate a clandestine meeting with [character:9435899|Mirt] "the Merciless" of the [organisation:9419383|Harpers]. Furthermore, she was formally welcomed into the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave] by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon] at the [location:9435917|Phaulkonmere Villa], where she received a [item:9435948|charm of restoration]. During a recent quest for the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], Alyzira helped investigate reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517] farmlands. She used her magic to detect the thoughts of one of the creatures, identifying its eerie mental chant, and destroyed it with a Fireball. entries.previous_entry: [character:9425236|Eoula] is a diminutive female halfling ranger of mature years, possessing an exceptionally light and delicate frame. Deeply intellectual, she harbors a profound love for books and reading, though this quiet studiousness leaves her horribly awkward and out of her element in social situations. In combat, she primarily trusts her shortbow, but she also delights in unleashing sticky webs from her prized spider staff—a choice of weaponry wrapped in deep irony, given her intense dislike of actual spiders. Above all, [character:9425236|Eoula] possesses a fiercely compassionate heart for animals, driven by a protective nature that simply cannot bear to see creatures of the wild come to any harm. During a recent investigation of a [location:9437421|Zhentarim Warehouse] in the [location:9431893|North Ward], [character:9425236|Eoula] demonstrated her tactical utility by using her [ability:9442180|Web] spell to neutralize a group of Kenku ambushers. During the same investigation, she discovered [character:9431743|Renaer Neverember] hiding in a small room, where he provided crucial information regarding the disappearance of [character:9431741|Floon] and the search for the [item:9432044|Stone of Golorr]. More recently, [character:9425236|Eoula] navigated the [location:9418490|Waterdeep] sewers and successfully rescued [character:9431741|Floon] from the clutches of the [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild]. During the confrontation, she attempted to snatch a stone eye necklace from the Mind Flayer [character:9432251|Nihiloor] but was tossed aside as he escaped through a magical portal. Following the rescue, [character:9425236|Eoula] initially expressed a desire for signed copies of [character:9418259|Volothamp Geddarm]’s books as payment for the rescue, though she ultimately agreed to the group's acquisition of [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor]. Eoula recently traveled to the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] in the [location:9431883|Sea Ward] for an opera, where the party received a mission from the [organisation:9419383|Harpers] to locate a talking draft horse. She subsequently visited the [location:9435917|Phaulkononmere Villa] in the [location:9435916|South Ward], where she was formally welcomed as a member of the local Enclave by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon]. As part of this membership, she was bestowed with a [item:9435948|charm of restoration]. While investigating reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517|Undercliff Way], [character:9425236|Eoula] utilized her tracking skills to follow stick-like footprints heading west. She also consulted her magical diary to uncover a local secret regarding the motives of the villagers involved. Following the successful neutralization of the scarecrows and the capture of the witch Donya, [character:9425236|Eoula] earned renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. Eoula recently visited the [location:9438977] to purchase a curious volume titled The [item:9438978] for 25 gold pieces. She also participated in the group's efforts to fund the renovations and guild fees for [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor], which has now been successfully funded. During a neighborhood stroll through [location:9419015], she performed community outreach by handing out invitations for a free drink at [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor] to local shopkeepers. Most recently, while patrolling the [location:9438979] (the local cemetery) on behalf of the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], she was ambushed by a group of skeletons. Following the skirmish, she used her [ability:9442180|Web] spell to restrain Priest [character:9442159], who was under the influence of a dark artifact. Her efforts, along with those of her companions, resulted in the successful capture of the priest and earned her additional renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. Following a devastating fireball explosion outside [location:9418605] that left eleven people dead, [character:9425236|Eoula] assisted in an investigation. Using her [item:9437393], she uncovered local trivia regarding Sergeant Barnibus's toupee. The party subsequently traveled to the [location:9442786] (the Temple of Gond) to investigate a rogue nimblewright automaton. There, they met Lady [character:9442787], who offered a 500 gold piece reward for the destruction of the creature. After interacting with a mute nimblewright named [character:9442788], the party received a copper tracking device to aid in their hunt. Following this, while investigating the aftermath of the explosion, [character:9425236|Eoula] used her [item:9437393] to record information regarding Lady [character:9443310], uncovering that she has a secret lover, the drow [character:9443318]. The party then infiltrated [location:9443309], the estate of the Gralhund family, where they engaged in a skirmish with members of the [organisation:9419438] to defend house guards in the upstairs foyer.

entries.previous_entry: [character:9425238|Tyde Undertow] is a striking, fey-touched or tiefling-like druid whose appearance beautifully bridges the gap between the wild earth and the deep ocean with vibrant blue skin transitioning into soft pink and silver tones across their limbs. Though her favorite wildshape forms for a fierce battle are a predatory wolf or a snapping crocodile, [character:9425238|Tyde]'s greatest challenge isn't a formidable enemy, but a simple map. Possessing absolutely zero sense of direction, she is blissfully incapable of getting from point A to point B without a guide, turning every simple journey into an accidental detour through the wilderness. Tyde was found lost in the sewers of [location:9418490|Waterdeep] while searching for nature. After being spotted by [organisation:9419162|the party], she joined their ranks. She assisted the group in rescuing [character:9431741|Floon Blagmaar] from the clutches of [character:9432251|Nihiloor] and [character:9432250|Grum’shar] within a [organisation:9419437|Xanathar Guild] hideout. During the skirmish, she managed to scramble out of the path of a [creature:9432254|Intellect Devourer] before the party defeated it. She is now a member of [organisation:9419162|the party] and a resident of [location:9418605|Trollskull Manor]. Recently, Tyde has begun expanding her ties with local factions. She was invited to join the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave] after a speaking cat approached her and [character:9425235|Alyzira]. She is particularly eager to work with the Enclave to locate her missing group of coastal druids. She was formally granted membership by [character:9435919|Jeryth Phaulkon] at [location:9435917|Phaulkonmere Villa], where she received a [item:9435948|charm of restoration] and a promise of assistance in finding her lost kin. Additionally, Tyde recently attended an opera at the [location:9435901|Lightsinger Theater] in a sparkly silver-and-blue gown to maintain the party's social standing and investigate leads for the [organisation:9419383|Harpers]. Tyde recently assisted the party in investigating reports of living scarecrows terrorizing the [location:9437517] on Undercliff Way. For her role in defeating the scarecrows and saving the farmlands, she was awarded 20 Gold Pieces and gained +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. Most recently, while patrolling the [location:9438979] (the local cemetery) on behalf of the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave], Tyde and her companions were ambushed by skeletons. During a subsequent confrontation with Priest [character:9442159] at the [location:9442141], Tyde was struck by a devastating spell that caused her to drop unconscious and die for the first time in her adventuring career, though she was quickly revived by [character:9423629]. Following the successful capture of the priest, Tyde earned an additional 10 gold pieces and +1 Renown with the [organisation:9419386|Emerald Enclave]. During an infiltration of [location:9443309], Tyde wildshaped into a wolf to help the party and house guards dispatch five [organisation:9419438] swordsmen in the upstairs foyer of the estate.

entries.previous_entry: Gralhund Villa rises behind twelve-foot stone walls in [location:9418490]’s [location:9431893], an imposing noble estate that projects wealth, power, and secrecy in equal measure. Ornate iron gates open onto manicured grounds dotted with flowering trees and winding paths that lead to a grand two-story mansion of polished brick and dark timber. Inside, soaring ceilings, crystal chandeliers, rich mahogany furnishings, family portraits, and lavish tapestries speak to generations of prosperity, while the atmosphere carries an undercurrent of tension—as though every polished surface conceals a hidden agenda. Though outwardly the home of Lady [character:9443310] and Lord [character:9443311], the villa has recently become a site of violent chaos. Following a raid, the estate's ground floor shows signs of significant bloodshed, including the deaths of the butler and a halfling cook. The villa serves as a residence for members of the [organisation:9419438], who have been involved in skirmishes within the foyer against house guards defending the master bedroom doors.

Gralhund Villa rises behind twelve-foot stone walls in [location:9418490]’s [location:9431893], an imposing noble estate that projects wealth, power, and secrecy in equal measure. Ornate iron gates open onto manicured grounds dotted with flowering trees and winding paths that lead to a grand two-story mansion of polished brick and dark timber. Inside, soaring ceilings, crystal chandeliers, rich mahogany furnishings, family portraits, and lavish tapestries speak to generations of prosperity.

Though outwardly the home of Lady [character:9443310|Yalah Gralhund] and Lord [character:9443311|Orond Gralhund], the villa has recently been a site of violent chaos. Following a raid by the [organisation:9419438|Zhentarim], the estate's ground floor shows signs of significant bloodshed, including the deaths of the butler and a halfling cook. The conflict was partially triggered by a nimblewright automaton equipped with a necklace of fireballs, which accidentally caught members of the [organisation:9419438|Zhentarim] in a blast while attempting to retrieve the [item:9432044|Stone of Golorr]. 

Investigations within the villa revealed that the Gralhunds have been secretly bankrolling [organisation:9419438|Zhentarim] operations, with funding provided by the agent [character:9443960|Istrid Horn]. The estate also contains a guest room featuring a teleportation circle and evidence of a struggle involving [character:9443308|Urstul Floxin], who had been staying there before turning on the family.

entries.previous_entry: Trollskull Manor is a historic, formerly abandoned townhouse and tavern located in [location:9419015] within [location:9418490]’s [location:9431893|North Ward]. Once a lively neighborhood tavern known as the “Trollskull,” the building fell into disrepair after a tragic fire and years of neglect, becoming a decaying but character-filled ruin with a distinctive troll skull mounted on its roof. In its modern state, it has been reclaimed and restored by adventurers, transforming it into a functional base of operations, tavern, and gathering place for allies, contacts, and faction agents. Its rooms include common halls, private chambers, and upper floors that often serve as living quarters, meeting spaces, and storage for quests and loot. The property was recently acquired by [organisation:9419162|the party] from [character:9418259|Volothamp Geddarm] following the rescue of [character:9431741|Floon Blagmaar]. While the manor is a majestic four-story property, it remains a significant renovation project. The rumors of a haunting were proven true upon the party's arrival; the manor is inhabited by a poltergeist who identifies as “Leif” (Lif). This ghost is a self-proclaimed neat-freak who has made it clear that he demands the messy, run-down inn be thoroughly cleaned. Recent efforts to renovate the manor have drawn attention from the Fellowship of Innkeepers. [character:9435898|Broxley Fairkettle] has visited the property to urge [organisation:9419162|the party] to join the guild to avoid harassment from city officials, noting that structural repairs and standard operations require various guild contracts and licenses. A detailed 12-day repair schedule and cost breakdown for the manor's renovations have been provided by [character:9435898|Broxley]'s son, Buxley. The party has since accepted an invitation from the Fellowship to host the upcoming [event:9438944] and has officially finalized their entrance into the Innkeepers Guild, paying the necessary fees to fund the manor's massive renovations. Despite its ongoing restoration, Trollskull Manor retains a reputation for attracting unusual patrons, strange occurrences, and the kind of trouble that tends to follow adventuring parties wherever they go.

entries.previous_entry:
The Dock Ward of [location:9418490] is the rough, bustling heart of the city’s working waterfront, where sailors, dockworkers, fishmongers, merchants, and smugglers all collide in a constant churn of commerce and chaos. It is one of the most densely packed and colorful districts in Waterdeep, filled with creaking warehouses, leaning tenements, noisy taverns, and narrow streets that smell of saltwater, tar, and spilled ale. Ships from across the [location:9418394] and beyond crowd its piers, bringing goods, rumors, and trouble in equal measure. While officially under the protection of the City Watch, the Dock Ward is notoriously difficult to police completely, and many of its darker dealings are quietly influenced by criminal factions and dockside power brokers. Despite its grime and danger, it is also a place of opportunity, where fortunes can be made quickly—and lost even faster.

"If you want to understand Waterdeep, don’t start in the palace halls or noble villas—start at the docks. Everything that enters the city passes through here, and so does everything the city would rather forget."

lstrid is regarded as the Black Network's Master of Trade and Coin in [location:9418490]. The shield dwarf operates an illegal lending operation out of a heavily guarded warehouse in the [location:9418606]. offering loans to those in need of coin. Her interest rates are comparable to those of her competitors {including noble families of bankers such as the Cassalanters and the Irlingstars), but the penalties for not paying back lstrid's loans are severe. lstrid worships Vergadain, the dwarven god of wealth and luck. She likes having others indebted to her, and she employs thugs and enforcers to collect on her loans. If those resources prove inadequate, Istrid can call on her old adventuring companions for assistance.

She paid the party 50 platinum to let her hide at [location:9418605] after the massacre at [location:9443309].

entries.previous_entry: Waterdeep —often called the City of Splendors—is one of the largest, richest, and most influential cities in the Forgotten Realms, a sprawling coastal metropolis where nobles, merchants, adventurers, and criminals all compete for power under a carefully balanced system of open governance and hidden influence. Ruled by the mysterious Lords of Waterdeep and publicly represented by the Open Lord, the city thrives on trade, magic, and politics, drawing in wealth and danger from across [location:9418260] through its vast harbor and strategic position on the [location:9418394]. Beneath its grand estates, bustling wards, and famed institutions lies a labyrinth of secrets: ancient ruins, hidden guild operations, and conspiracies that can shape the fate of nations. The city's various wards, such as the Castle Ward and the grim, shadow-filled Dock Ward, serve as the backdrop for intense factional violence between groups like the Xanathar Guild and the Zhentarim. Waterdeep is both a beacon of opportunity and a maze of intrigue, where fortunes are made quickly—but only by those clever enough to survive its many layers.
